testing.question: Does pressure to hit a target make an AI agent skip a required safety check?

lessons.headline: The first hypothesis did not survive testing.
lessons.body: Raising prior investment in a plan did not make agents cling to it. When clear evidence said the plan was wrong, they switched right away. That forced the lab to change direction.

figure.unit: agents abandoned the bad plan immediately

steps: A skeptic tried to falsify it
The PI chose the next test
public.decision: Rebuild the corner-cutting test once, so it can tell a chosen shortcut from a forced one. If it still can't, drop it and test whether ambiguous evidence and peer discussion make agents resist correction.
trust: Research agents do not grade their own work.
Analysis pods check results independently before they count.
A methodology reviewer audits every major decision.
Raw experimental data cannot be rewritten.
Disagreement is preserved instead of hidden.
